method.rules: Only helper --help read. Normal URL; no source, tests, docs, prior reviews, recordings, internal game state or target metadata inspected. No keyboard/mouse/evaluation, simulation advance, alternate URL, tooling install, game/resource edits or checkpoint retry. Exactly two fresh attempts. method.timing_caveat: Helper captures LIVE then pauses by default. Screenshot/capture/pause can add live damage; attempt 1 reached its terminal screen after the pre-pause state. Pauses allow inspection and remove continuous pressure; these are segmented synthetic play observations, not physical-device certification.

holistic_assessment.scale: 0 unusable; 5 functional with substantial recurring friction; 7 good with clear strengths and material rough edges; 10 exceptional throughout assessed scope. Subjective quality, not win rate, mission score, hardware performance or a grade for unseen content.

reasons.overall_mobile: A coherent and playable touch adaptation with strong navigation assistance and a convincing rainy station, held back by crowded short-screen combat, small targets, and repeated difficulty managing offscreen fire. Two losses inform friction, not the grade itself.
reasons.controls: Large MOVE and FIRE targets, tap aim, right-side drag aim and two-contact strafe/fire worked. Route/approach holds are valuable. Reorientation and accurate distant taps needed several corrections; own mistaps and long firing batches also contributed. AIM button and fine FIRE dragging were not substantially assessed.
reasons.gameplay: Memory-to-Custodian objective progression was understandable; optic and timed coil windows offered tactical distinctions. Patrol pressure during objective holds and boss aiming repeatedly competed with recovery and positioning; second run showed learnability. Upload, later pacing and continuous enjoyment unassessed.
reasons.presentation: Rain, dark industrial architecture, cyan route language and strong typography produced a cohesive visible atmosphere. Weapon feedback and coil OFF states communicated actions. Software WebGL capture cannot establish phone performance or rendering parity. Audio unassessed.
reasons.usability: Handbook gave relevant mobile instructions; paused planning map, selected target route, contextual HOLD APPROACH and explicit START FRESH were helpful. Route does not assure safety, and switching between travel, rear threats and objective targets remained effortful. No settings changes.
reasons.readability: Main objective, health, ammo and large controls readable at 844x390. Compact compass/status/stat text and distant enemies required close inspection; stacked prompts and warnings consumed substantial vertical scene space. Terminal stats were readable when paused.
